art_direction: 淡紫粉短卷发女性在雨后明亮街角轻跨浅水洼，淡蓝短袖长裙与合拢黄伞充满活力。
composition_variation: Design a lively original anime wallpaper featuring a visibly adult 25-year-old woman stepping around a shallow puddle after a brief summer sunshower. She has clear teal eyes, elegant eyebrows, a refined nose, smooth warm skin, and a bright confident smile that still reads mature. Her pale lilac-pink wavy bob reaches her chin and falls from a soft side part. She wears an opaque light-blue short-sleeved cotton midi dress with a modest crew neckline, a relaxed waist, and practical white sneakers. Capture one small natural step onto dry paving, with her torso upright and both arms kept close. One hand carries a closed butter-yellow umbrella downward beside her leg; the other steadies a compact cream crossbody bag. Avoid jumping, exaggerated limb spread, or windswept clothing. Wet pavement reflects pastel shopfront colors without any readable signs. A faint rainbow may sit low in the far background, while the upper sky stays clean and pale. Soft renewed sunlight gives her face a fresh glow and creates restrained pavement sparkle. Use delicate anime linework, believable movement, and a joyful everyday atmosphere. Use an eye-level portrait composition, with one person centered in the middle-to-lower frame and hands held within the central crop. Leave the upper quarter as clean pale sky or light for the lock-screen clock.
